evidence.decision: Selects hierarchy versus flat table, keeps ancestry in the primary column and sorts siblings while preserving expansion and editing/open semantics.
evidence.artifact: Delivers tree/sort/selection artifact plus sibling-order, restored-expansion and editing contracts.
evidence.transformation: Project-size sort stops moving children above parents and sorts within each folder while restoring expanded branches after return.
evidence.verification: Tests recursive collapse, duplicate names, reversal, resize and selected removal; fails orphans, lost branch state and unexpected edit/open action.
evidence.applicability: Keeps conventional outline scope macOS-only, adapts other platforms and does not infer operational accessibility from indented rows.
evidence.handoffs: Routes traversal without attributes to Column views and coordinated detail to Split views.
evidence.distinctiveness: Ancestry-preserving sort, recursive expansion and click semantics cannot be exchanged for an ordinary table checklist.
